description.simple: Alphabet est la maison mere de Google, fondee en 1998 avec pour mission d'organiser l'information du monde et de la rendre universellement accessible et utile. Le groupe est une collection d'entreprises dont la plus importante est Google, presente dans la vie quotidienne de milliards de personnes avec des produits comme la recherche Google, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Gmail, Google Maps, Google Play et l'assistant Gemini. La quasi-totalite des revenus provient de la publicite en ligne diffusee sur la recherche, YouTube et les sites partenaires. Le groupe vend aussi des abonnements, des applications et des appareils, et propose des services d'informatique en nuage aux entreprises via Google Cloud.
description.advanced: Alphabet est une societe holding dont la plus grande filiale est Google. Le groupe se decrit comme une entreprise orientee intelligence artificielle (AI-first) depuis 2016 et reporte ses activites en trois ensembles : deux segments Google, soit Google Services et Google Cloud, et l'ensemble des activites non-Google regroupees sous Other Bets, avec des activites de recherche AI centralisees au niveau d'Alphabet. Google Services genere ses revenus principalement par la publicite a la performance et de marque diffusee sur la recherche Google et autres proprietes, YouTube et les proprietes du Google Network, ainsi que par les abonnements grand public (YouTube TV, YouTube Music et Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, Google One), la plateforme Google Play et les appareils de la famille Pixel. Google Cloud genere ses revenus essentiellement via des frais a la consommation et des abonnements pour l'infrastructure, les plateformes et les applications, autour de Google Cloud Platform et Google Workspace, avec une infrastructure optimisee pour l'AI (TPU custom et GPU specialises) et la plateforme de developpement Vertex AI. Other Bets regroupe des entreprises a divers stades de maturite, de la recherche (X, la moonshot factory) a la commercialisation, dont Waymo dans la conduite autonome et Isomorphic Labs dans la decouverte de medicaments, avec des revenus issus principalement du transport autonome et de services internet. Le groupe adopte une approche full-stack de l'AI couvrant infrastructure, recherche et modeles de pointe, dont Gemini 3, integres dans ses produits. Alphabet evolue dans un environnement tres concurrentiel face aux moteurs de recherche, plateformes publicitaires, fournisseurs de cloud d'entreprise, developpeurs de modeles AI et fabricants de materiel grand public.

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets.
Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998.
It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company.

Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.

Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties ("Google Network properties").

Google Services generates revenues from products and services beyond advertising, including: • consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models; • platforms , which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases; and • devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices.

Through our Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace offerings, Google Cloud generates revenues primarily from consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services.
Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.

In Other Bets, our fully autonomous driving technology company, Waymo, is now providing fully autonomous, paid ride-hailing services to customers in multiple cities. Isomorphic Labs is reimagining the drug discovery process from first principles, applying AI to accelerate the development of new medicines.

We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises.
